active_continuity: Taekyung has awakened at the bomb shelter battlefield, where Choi Minwoo leads more than two hundred Hunters.
The Hunters are fighting monsters, including named enemies with exceptionally durable, rapidly regenerating bodies.
Taekyung and the Skeleton King are reunited allies and friends; the Skeleton King has grown much stronger.
The Grand Mage’s destructive attack rains down on the monsters, and Taekyung recognizes her as his friend.
The coalition army of more than two hundred thousand is crossing the Taklamakan Desert toward Tianshan.
Jeok Cheongang remains beside Taekyung and intends to protect him on the march to Tianshan.
Taekyung promised Jeok Cheongang he would return.
The Grand Mage has been reborn through the Lord of Heaven’s grace; she previously felt a wave, and the Lord said the heavens had opened again as green light rose over jade.
open_questions: What caused the wave the Grand Mage felt, and what does the Lord of Heaven mean by the heavens opening again?
What danger awaits the coalition army at Tianshan?
Who are the named monsters, and what accounts for their exceptional durability and regeneration?
